results.reason: Section 3 says the First Supplement (Sept. 14, Ferrovane, about 18% of revenue) window ended without notice. It explains that under §5.7(c) this waived the termination right and cured the §4.8 inaccuracy for indemnity and closing-condition purposes. It also states Harrowgate has no §9.2(a) claim.

Section 4.1 contrasts the SPA Losses definition with the Escrow's 'actual out-of-pocket' definition, which excludes diminution in value, lost profits and attorneys' fees. It notes §4.3 pays only Escrow-defined Losses and that SPA §11.11 gives the Escrow control of disbursement mechanics, which limits recovery and invites dispute.

Section 1 covers MSA §14.2 (deemed assignment at >50% voting equity) and says the 100% share purchase triggers it. It notes Annex 7.2(d) lists only lender items, so consent is not a §7.2(d) condition, and that §4.4 is inaccurate. It describes the termination or List Price repricing risk from a supplier with an 85% requirements commitment.
States the 10-Business-Day window 'ended about September 28, 2026' following the Sept. 14 delivery.
